title: Tap Tap Revenge: Nirvana
notes: Physical ARM64 test on 2026-11-03 with exact IPA SHA-256 bd3d74b23c94bc5da1afe8b99bc6e6902dafd0ec061295d24ecbaaf52e86ac88. Career lists bundled Breed and Lithium. Breed reached live notes and Game Stats in three bounded runs; two complete-song result files recorded is_complete=true. A no-input control scored 0/520 hits. In a separate run, 144 injected touches across three fret centers scored 58/520 hits (11.15% accuracy), proving note input reaches gameplay, not calibrated human timing. The result-screen High Scores tab displayed the completed run and Home returned to the menu; a fresh process launch reached the menu again. The test-created score-submission file survived that restart with the same SHA-256, but visual reloading of the old score after restart was not checked. On 2026-11-04 a fresh ARM64 run on the current APK reached Breed again: after Super Duper Pause, the guest displayed Game Paused; guest Resume, followed by Super Duper Continue, returned to live notes. Scores at 10 and 22 seconds after Continue changed from -4,080 to -5,520, with different note positions, proving continued rendering and game progression. This is a combined guest/native pause-resume path, not proof of native-only pause behavior. Original guest preferences were restored after the test; the test-created score file was archived locally and removed from the phone. Song loading can exceed 100 seconds. Audible music/quality, Lithium, other modes, visual reloading of old scores and long-run stability remain unverified. Rating 3/5 is for this bounded Breed path only, not complete playability.
